notes: Router's fetch-failed was a real TLS cert/hostname mismatch (site is on Netlify with an unmatched cert); refetched with curl -k (ignoring cert validation only, no data altered) and got a normal 200. The own site itself has a real priced food menu (not just a drink list) but marks roughly half its items 'Ask Server' with no number - those were dropped per the never-write-a-dish-without-a-price rule, leaving only 13 usable items there. Found real Uber Eats/Grubhub/DoorDash links in the site's own 'Order Online' section (the router's fetch-failure meant it never reached these). DoorDash's store page (address-confirmed 274 Harbor Drive) served a full 91-item catalog; the 'Most Ordered' section was 100% duplicate of items in the real categories and dropped entirely, leaving 79 dishes across 9 sections (Handhelds, Burgers, Appetizers, Breakfast, Sausages, Wraps, South of the Border, Small Bites, Crisp Green Eats). Cross-checked DoorDash against the restaurant's own site: 8 of 10 comparable items matched exactly (Tony's Ultimate Burger $17.95, Harbor Burger $17.95, Classic Cheeseburger $14.95, Patty Melt $14.95, Turkey Bacon Melt $15.95, Jetty Sampler $14.95, Wings-8pc $15.45, Breakfast Burrito $15.45); two disagreed (Nina's Choice: site $12.95 vs DoorDash $9.95; Chicken Caesar Avocado Wrap: site $14.95 vs DoorDash $14.45) and DoorDash's figure was kept for both since it is the fuller/live source - flagging rather than silently picking. Markup test (divide by 1.04/1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3/0.96) found no dominant divisor (best was 19% at 1.15); cent endings are 92% .95, matching the own site's .95 pricing convention, so no delivery surcharge.
